lines.zh: 我悬在半空，脚下没有影子。
lines.en: I hover with no shadow beneath me.

lines.zh: 身体前后轻晃，像被线牵着。
lines.en: My body sways as if strung on a thread.
I drift along the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 衣角在身后拖出一道冷气。
lines.en: My hem trails a line of cold.
My steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块礁石，又回来。
lines.en: I pass a reef stone, then come back.
I am hunting for what was left behind.

lines.zh: 手指划过石面，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My fingers score the stone lightly.
I pause for one breath, then drift on.
I drift toward the shore.
The sea wind passes through me.
When the wind pushes, I lean with it.
I hang there, utterly still.
My eyes half close, as if listening.
The light around me dims slightly.
I am counting the ripples on the sea.
By the seventh it goes wrong.
I start again.
My hem hangs, never touching ground.

lines.zh: 有一只鸟从我身体穿过。
lines.en: A bird passes through my body.
It does not notice.
Neither do I.
A bell sounds far off.
I turn my head.
That is not where I belong.
I turn back.
I am waiting to be picked up.
Or forgotten.
I raise my eyes; my pupils are slits.
Your hem carries the smell of salt.
I turn my face aside to look at you.
My hand stops in the air.
You step back.
I drift a little after you.
I mean no harm.
Though I cannot say for sure.
What are you looking for?
I might know where it is.
I point toward the sea.
Then draw my hand back.
You stop breathing, and I do the same.
Wind opens my hem.

lines.zh: 我没有叫，只是晃了一下。
lines.en: I do not cry out; I only waver.
A corner of my fingers is gone.
The wound does not bleed; it is just empty.
I retreat far.
I must gather myself again.
My body shakes like cloth in wind.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸被破开的地方。
lines.en: I feel the place where I was torn.
Still here.
I raise my eyes.
You scattered something.

lines.zh: 我的胃里什么都装不下。
lines.en: There's nothing in me that can hold food.
Such a thing is empty to me.
I reach out, then withdraw.
I cannot smell it.
I look at you.
You need this more than I do.
I let my hand fall; that's my answer.
I do not need to be fed.
I only want to be found.
I turn and drift away.
You step straight through my hem.
I recoil too.

lines.zh: 我的指尖碰到你的肩甲。
lines.en: My fingertips brush your shoulder plate.
You turn, and I'm right at your back.
I am right beside you.
My hem wraps your leg.
You shake it twice before it lets go.
A thin frost forms on the ground.
I drift a little away.
Sorry.
I have nothing of that kind.
I was made.
This body is borrowed.
I turn my palm up to look at the seam.
The fingertips are transparent.
I hide them in my sleeve.
This is not mine to ask.
The sea still sounds.
I fall quiet.
Like cloth left too long.

lines.zh: 我伸手，把那东西托起来。
lines.en: I reach out and lift it.
It floats in my palm.

lines.zh: 我托了一会儿，又放回去。
lines.en: I hold it a while, then set it back.
This is not what I seek.
This one is interesting.
My sleeve sags and the thing is gone.
My sleeve bulges once.
Then I take it out again.
And put it back.
I am waiting for the real one.
I lift my eyes from my sleeve.
Someone touched what was mine.
Something over there just shifted.
My eyes are open.
The light around me fails.
I drift over an inch above the ground.

lines.zh: 衣摆碰到地面，草就枯了。
lines.en: My hem touches the grass and it withers.
I float without stirring a speck of dust.
I measure how many steps remain.
Seventy-two blocks is enough.
I reach out.
I have arrived.
I follow without feet.
As fast as you go, I go.
You look back; I stop in the light.
The light dims and I am closer.
My hand is an inch behind you.
I have not touched you.
Not yet.
Your breathing quickens.
I hear it perfectly.
I'm already on the path you're taking.
You only realise when you hit me.
The air cools.
The corner of my mouth moves.
My hand passes through your arm.
Your whole arm goes numb.
I grab the shadow at your feet.
You cannot move.
I pull it toward me.
You are dragged one step.
My hem brushes your face.
You see a stretch of sea.
It is not real.
I open my fingers and let you go.

lines.zh: 空气里先出现一道裂口。
lines.en: A seam opens in the air first.
I drift out of it.
My feet do not touch ground.
The light around drops a shade.
I look around.
The sea is close here.
I can smell the salt.
I raise my hand and look at it.
Still the same.
I drift toward the sea.
A line of frost is left behind me.
Each trace fades fast.
Someone is looking for me.
I can feel it.
Fire passes through and my edges melt.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下，摔成一团雾。
lines.en: I fall and break into mist.
Seawater pours in; water does not frighten me.
The blast scatters me.
It passes through my shoulder.
Magic pins me in the air.
I have no sense of hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈进身体，光从里面透出来。
lines.en: Lightning enters me and light shines through.

lines.zh: 虚空和我很像，但它更空。
lines.en: The void is like me, but emptier.
